home.intro: One-sentence description of the group: research positioning and team size, around 40-80 words. Replace brand / siteName and this paragraph to establish the first impression.

highlights.title: Research Directions
highlights.desc: List 3-4 main research directions, one sentence each on what problem is studied. Visitors usually judge fit against this section first.

highlights.title: Recent Outputs
highlights.desc: Summarize representative outputs from the past two years: papers at specific venues, granted patents, delivered systems. Avoid padding with raw counts.

highlights.title: Recruitment & Collaboration
highlights.desc: Actively recruiting master's and PhD students as well as undergraduate research interns, and open to joint projects and joint training with industry and institutes.
